d: Wavy, shoulder-length jet black hair with side-swept bangs frames a youthful, mature face and slender build. The eyes are a deep amber with a calm, focused expression. The outfit consists of a rust-orange blazer under a long tan trench coat, paired with a grey plaid midi skirt, a dark brown belt, and black pointed-toe heels. Signature details include a small orange humanoid figure perched on the shoulder and a mechanical wheelchair featuring large orange-rimmed wheels and a mounted studio spotlight.
